purpose: Development pilot and benchmark qualification; not confirmatory praxis evidence
primary_pilot_dataset: AIT-LDS v2.1 intranet source logs with exact source-line labels
split_rationale: Earlier January runs fit; later January runs develop/calibrate; February runs test. Whole runs retained. Scenario generation shares attack recipes, so this is held-out execution transfer, not unseen APT family transfer.
prediction_unit: Original line in a qualified source log; not an independent attack or analyst alert
label_policy: Author-provided exact original-line annotations. Only paired, author-covered source files permit unannotated lines to mean normal. Missing source/label pairing is unknown and excluded.
feature_view: Same normalized log text and source type, fixed 128-dimensional nonnegative hashed unigram/bigram representation for every CPU model; no target, rule, scenario, line number or timestamp metadata inputs. Recognized timestamp, header-host, address and numeric-ID patterns are masked; unstructured usernames, paths and payloads may retain lexical identity.
hyperparameter_search: None; fixed model specifications. Development set is an engineering diagnostic, not used to select a winner.

calibration.guarantee: None. Finite-sample observed operating point, not certified risk control or a host-hour alert budget.

stages: Report source-defined attack-step detection recall and stage-vs-normal diagnostic metrics for every binary detector. Separately fit one-vs-rest logistic regression (balanced classes, max_iter1000, same128features, fixed0.5 threshold) for multilabel source-step identification. Targets come from fit labels only; report unseen test stages. Overlapping author labels are not ordered kill-chain states.
early_detection: Only source-event time where explicitly parseable; idealized replay excludes unknown acquisition/inference delay. No before-impact metric or benign-host-hour rate without verified impact and exposure annotations.
uncertainty: Two test runs; report each run and equal-run macro. No population confidence claim from correlated log rows or repeated seeds.
confirmatory_next_gate: Freeze a new, attainable candidate-vs-baseline hypothesis after development, qualify temporal/impact labels and a fresh held-out data partition before confirmatory scoring. Pilot test outcomes are now development evidence.
